fullDescription: A high-impact brutalist showcase layout featuring a technical, 'blueprint' aesthetic. Characterized by a dark graphite background with a yellow neon grid pattern, the design uses a 3-column bento-style layout. It is optimized for portfolios, design agencies, and tech products that want to display scrolling previews of web designs or dashboards. Key elements include thick black borders, offset 'hard' shadows, and JetBrains Mono typography for a data-driven feel.

structured.summary: A brutalist dark-mode site showcase featuring three fixed-width cards that contain auto-scrolling internal website previews triggered by hover interactions, set against a technical blueprint grid background.

style.description: The style is a fusion of technical blueprinting and neo-brutalism. It uses a high-contrast palette of #1c1c1c (Graphite), #facc15 (Cyber Yellow), and #000000 (True Black). Typography pairs the heavy, uppercase 'Archivo Black' for headlines with 'JetBrains Mono' for all metadata and system-style labels. Elements feature 4px solid black borders and 8px hard-offset shadows with zero blur. Micro-interactions include smooth CSS transforms and linear-timed vertical content scrolling.
style.prompt: Create a brutalist UI with a background color of #1c1c1c featuring a subtle blueprint grid pattern (20px by 20px) created with linear-gradients of rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.05). Primary accent color is #facc15. Headlines must use 'Archivo Black', uppercase, with tracking-tighter. Body and UI labels must use 'JetBrains Mono'. UI elements must have a 4px solid #000000 border and a non-blurred box-shadow: 8px 8px 0px 0px #000000. Interactive cards should scale(1.02) and translate-y(-4px) on hover using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Animation for internal content: linear vertical translation over 8 seconds for the scroll-down phase, and ease-in-out translation over 1 second for the reset-to-top phase.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertically centered, single-page layout comprising a metadata-heavy header, a central 3-column grid of scrolling 'nodes', and a technical status-bar footer.

prompts.prompt: Full-width container with max-width 7xl. Top-left: A small yellow box (#facc15) with black text 'Blueprint v.02'. Main title: Massive 'Archivo Black' text (text-8xl) 'SHOW YOUR SITES'. Below the title, a 4px solid black border-bottom with technical metadata on the left ('SYSTEM SPECIFICATIONS') and frequency stats on the right in 10px JetBrains Mono.

A flex-row container with 3 equal-width columns (gap-6). Each column contains a 'Card Node'. The node has a fixed height of 60vh. Card structure: 1. Header bar (p-2) with a specific background color (Yellow, White, or Red) containing the node ID and an icon. 2. Main content area: A scrollable window with overflow-hidden. 3. Footer bar: Black background with yellow or red monospace status text ('PROTOCOL: HTTPS').

Inside the card viewport, simulate a full website. The content must be longer than the container (e.g., 200% height). Content should include a header, hero section with placeholder blocks, feature grids, and a footer. On parent hover, the internal div must translate Y from 0 to 'calc(-100% + 60vh)' over 8 seconds linearly.

Width-constrained 7xl footer. Left side: Three vertical yellow bars (#facc15) next to an 'Interface Hash' label. Right side: Copyright info and 'VIEWPORT: 1:1' status text in 10px gray-500 JetBrains Mono. Border-top is 2px solid white/10 opacity.

special_ui_components.description: A card that mimics a browser window, scrolling through a website preview on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: bg-black, 4px black border, 8px hard shadow. Inside: A wrapper div with style 'transition: transform 8s linear'. On hover, set transform: translateY(calc(-100% + containerHeight)). On mouse-out, set transition: transform 1s ease-in-out and transform: translateY(0). This creates the effect of 'inspecting' a full page.

Height-constrained box, bg-#facc15, text-#000, font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', font-weight: bold, text-size: 10px, uppercase, padding-x: 4px, padding-y: 1px. Used in headers to denote system version or status.

structured.special_notes: MUST NOT use rounded corners; every edge must be a sharp 90-degree angle. MUST NOT use soft shadows; all shadows must be solid black offsets. MUST use fixed widths for the 3 columns to prevent layout shifts during internal scroll. The hover-scroll effect must reset immediately or with a fast transition (1s) when the mouse leaves the card.
